protocol.counterpart_definition: Other text-bearing lines on the same catalogue reference, excluding every selected exact stroke+U field. Do not assume one universal main side.
protocol.downloads: Use already downloaded primary PDF and existing sign inventory; any new download remains data/raw and must enter data/sources.json.
protocol.method: Primary Texts or complete Concordance left-column counterpart context; all displayed nonselected text-bearing lines must be accounted for, preserving side/line; symbol-only entries recorded separately without inventing a sign sequence. Candidate export may suggest IDs but cannot authenticate a glyph. Record UNKNOWN for unresolved visible glyphs; LOSS for positive unknown-length damage, asterisk for source doubt.
